decisions.reason: The existing message-225 MODIFY already places fiat-buyer reward access in the POST_LAUNCH context, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The existing message-225 MODIFY already records the Transak fiat mint as a POST_LAUNCH context without changing its eventual behavior.
Delaying Transak availability does not change the primary-sale allocation amounts or rules.
The source preserves launch through crypto and does not change the $15 primary mint price or advertised price commitment.
The unlimited NFT ebook mint remains available through the initial crypto flow; only the Transak path is postponed.
The source does not change the optional tipping behavior, placement, or supported tip amounts.

The approved FAQ describes Transak and fiat-buyer behavior as available, but the source does not determine whether those sections should be hidden until post-launch, retained as future-facing copy, or revised to say coming soon.
The referral code remains the permanent mint number across crypto and eventual fiat flows; postponing Transak does not alter its identity or display rules.
The current About-page requirements do not promise day-one Transak availability, and their mint, referral, prize, and technology copy remains valid.
The initial focus on crypto users is compatible with the existing SIWE requirement and does not change its authentication method or required flows.
Postponing Transak does not change automatic prize transfer or winner-announcement behavior.
The $5 coded-referral commission remains active for qualifying mints and is not changed by the timing of the Transak payment path.
